Q: Is it possible to specify WebSphere classloader delegation mode in a WAR file? A:

Try:

Click Servers > Server Types > WebSphere application servers > server_name

I believe you could set the Server class loader to the server scope and than all apps deployed to it, unless overwritten, would follow.

Further info is here.

Q: What is typical webgl MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE in 2023? A:

According to the OpenGL Hardware Database with ~17,000 entries, the typical value for MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE as of July 2026 is 16384 (~71.5%), followed by 32768 (~19.5%) and 8192 (~7.5%). So in total ~98.5% support a MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE of at least 8192.

Strictly speaking, this value is driver-specific, so you might get different values on the same GPU but with a different driver. However, the OpenGL Hardware DB considers this.

Q: How to add frame in mkmapview A:

Why are you adding the UILabel as a subview to itself? i.e. [time addSubview:time]; Perhaps it should be [self addSubview:time]; if you're currently in the view where you want the label to be added?

Q: In gamesalad actor moves out of the screen on x-axis A:

It is way easier than that.

In top of the Gamesalad Creator there is a play button, which you probably know, displays your progress. To the left of this button there is a button that looks like a little video camera, it changes the camera settings. So what you first have to do is click the camera button, then the rectangular camera screen will show itself as marked. In the center of each of the sides of the highlighted rectangular which is the camera screen, sits 1 little grey rectangular. Each of these needs to be pulled to the center of the camera view so that you get a little grey "cross" in the center and from the center to the boarder there will now be this highlighted color.

Second and last step is easy, just go under your character and in (type or drag in a behavior block) you type control camera... or drag the control camera block, which as by the type box is statet possible.

Since Gamesalad only can have one camera at a time, and you character is the only one with the control camera option applied it will follow him and only him. Wherever your character starts on the screen, the camera will follow it when it passes through the center of the screen. You may know this from Super Mario Bros. Where you start of a little to the left and walk right and the second Mario enters the center of the screen, the camera follows him from then on.

Hope this helps... :

Q: PHP memcached Fatal error: Class 'Memcache' not found A:

To avoid confusion as this is an older question, a small prologue:

rubo77 refreshed this question by placing a bounty and asking for a canonical answer. Reading the little bit old but nevertheless still valid answers -- see esp. the accepted one -- , I realized that indeed some basic but important, so to say canonical, links miss.

So here shall be provided not a canonical answer as such -- which could change in details over the years -- but canonical links which will provide the answer.

The Missing Link

Sorry for the fossil joke ^^. Ok, back to serious. The main canonical source to answer the question is of course php.net, and more precisely:

  • Memcached Installation Guide, last updated 2020 by an accepted user contribution considering PHP 7.2.19. The extensive and up-to-date ServerPilot installation guide is also pretty useful.
  • Memcache Installation Guide, last updated 2022 by an accepted user contribution considering PHP 7.4

Naturally, the question comes up -- What about PHP 8.x ? Lets take a look into the respective repository, the PHP Extension Community Library (PECL), and we find:

  • The last Memcached package stable release 3.4.0 from 2025-10-13 depends on PHP>=7.0.0, so can also be used with PHP8.
  • The last Memcache package stable release 8.2 from 2023-04-30 depends on PHP>=8.0.0. For PHP>=7.0 take release 4.0.5.2 from 2019-12-20.

So these sources should be the very first places to look for (after Stackoverflow, of course), before starting a deeper web search campaign (which won't yield that much more, tbh).

Q: How can I connect to MgGraphs and Exchange Online in the same Powershell session? A:

Very possible that the cause is an assembly conflict between Graph and Exchange Online modules and either one implements an assembly load context... what you can try is updating both modules to their latest version and hope after that they both end up using the same version of the conflicting assembly, if that didn't work there is a common workaround using an outside process (Start-Job makes it pretty easy) to do the work with one of the conflicting modules:

Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'Application.ReadWrite.All', 'Directory.ReadWrite.All'
# Ask Admin the email of the user being deactivated
$User = Read-Host 'What account is being deactivated?'

# Disable account
$Disable = @{ AccountEnabled = 'false' }
Update-MgUser -UserId $User -BodyParameter $Disable

# No need to disconnect from Graph, connect to exchange in a different process:
Start-Job {
    Import-Module ExchangeOnlineManagement
    Connect-ExchangeOnline

    # Hide from GAL and convert to shared mailbox
    Set-Mailbox -Identity $using:User -Type Shared -HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled $true

    # Set Auto-reply message
    $setMailboxAutoReplyConfigurationSplat = @{
        Identity        = $using:User
        AutoReplyState  = 'Enabled'
        InternalMessage = 'Thank you for your message.'
        ExternalMessage = 'Thank you for your message.'
    }

    Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration @setMailboxAutoReplyConfigurationSplat
} | Receive-Job -Wait -AutoRemoveJob

# Remove Licenses
$License = Get-MgUserLicenseDetail -UserId $User
$LicenseData = @{
    addLicenses    = @()
    removeLicenses = @($License)
}
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $User -BodyParameter $LicenseData

Q: Find null, empty, or non-existent field in Datadog A:

I am trying to create a query in Datadog to check if a field exists

For that you can use:

@Request.Param.name:*

This will find records which have that attribute present with a non-empty value.

Look for "Not anything"

Find null, empty, or non-existent field in Datadog

For the title question, there isn’t a direct mechanism to look for the absence of something (actually there is - see the other answer or the docs) however another way of checking for absence is to negate the above condition and implicitly check for absence:

-@Request.Param.name:*

This will find records which have that attribute absent or present with an empty/falsy value.

Why didn't @Request.Param.name work

A brief note on this.

Neither of these are valid search syntax (tldr: does not include @attribute:expression):

  • !@Request.Param.name
  • -@Request.Param.name

In my experience the behavior of invalid syntax is one of:

  • An error message
  • Interpreted as a free-text search string (against the main message field)
  • Ignored

In these cases, they’d have no effect for different reasons:

  • !@Request.Param.name - invalid syntax, ignored
  • -@Request.Param.name - negating a free-text search, for text that is in no log message text
